warnings.message: The canonical model is derived from message INVOIC (2) in file INVFIL alone. This document carries 4 message(s) across 1 file(s); the remaining 3 are described here and nowhere else.

Read with the TRADACOMS profile. An `STX=` transmission header opens the document; it is not an EDIFACT `UNB`. The TRADACOMS manual's message specifications are not consulted: which segments a message may carry, their order and their code values are recorded as written, not checked.
